institution.name: United Nations Office of the High Representative for the Least Developed Countries, Landlocked Developing Countries and Small Island Developing States (UN-OHRLLS)

qualifications: Journalists from the 44 Least Developed Countries
Fellows must produce at least three substantive journalism outputs and share publication links by 30 April 2027
No application fee; late or incomplete applications are not considered
description_short: UN-OHRLLS funds 10 journalists from Least Developed Countries to report on the Doha Programme of Action High-level Midterm Review in Doha, 25-27 March 2027, with travel, a daily allowance and briefings. Fellows publish three stories.

compensation.value: Travel, a daily allowance and briefings
compensation.evidence_quote: Ten Fellows will receive travel, a daily allowance and briefings
